{{Quote|Easy, friend. We've traveled here from Tatooine with a cargo of sand wine. Is there a problem?|A spacer, to Imperial Customs Officer Tellix on Manforgon|<ref name="CRB">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>}}
'''Sand wine''' was a type of [[Wine/Legends|wine]]. When a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] landed on<ref name="CRB" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Manforgon]] at some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a crewmember of the vessel claimed to the local [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]] [[Customs official/Legends|Officer]] [[Tellix]] that the starship was carrying a cargo of sand wine.<ref name="CRB" />

{{Food-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Sand wine was mentioned in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook|core rulebook]] for the [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="CRB" />
